verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs say you can connect a Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 account, and that calendar events then automatically appear on the relevant CRM records. That covers the core of syncing a calendar so meetings show up on record timelines. The more detailed linking docs only describe emails being matched to Company and People records, so how meetings attach to contacts, and especially to deals, is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that meetings appear on deal/opportunity timelines, detail on how calendar events are matched to contacts, sync configuration options for calendar, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
